subject: Service smoothing proposal: credits + trial extension for Greenline Health
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Samir Shah <samir.shah@greenlinehealth.com>, Procurement <procurement@greenlinehealth.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-02T09:10:00-07:00
Subject: Brief: proposed service smoothing package after weekend latency

Samir / Procurement team —

Thanks again for flagging the elevated tail latency you saw over the weekend. First, apologies — this is not the experience we aim to deliver. Our SREs traced the root cause to an autoscaler race during a regional maintenance window; that should be fully mitigated now. Attached is a short incident report with timeline and mitigations (incident_report_2026-08-02.pdf).

To make this right and help you hit your product deadlines, we propose the following service smoothing package: 
- 400k token credit to be applied against your next two invoices (approx. $10k at current rate)
- 30-day trial extension on your Dedicated evaluation (adds capacity through Sep 30)
- Priority routing for your production traffic during the extension window

Next steps I propose:
1) If that package looks acceptable, confirm who should sign (PO vs amendment).
2) We'll prepare a short credit memo and a DocuSign amendment (no pricing changes) for Procurement.
3) Once signed, we’ll apply the token credit and activate the routing policy.

Open Qs: Do you want the credit applied as account-level invoice credit or as token top-up? Either is fine; just tell me which you prefer and I’ll route to finance.

I’ll loop in billing/approvals internally (cc Jonas) to get an expedited sign-off path.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Account Executive — Enterprise
Redwood Inference

Attachments: incident_report_2026-08-02.pdf
From: Samir Shah <samir.shah@greenlinehealth.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-02T10:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Brief: proposed service smoothing package after weekend latency

Marcus —

Thanks for the quick follow-up and for the incident report. The timeline helps. The package looks reasonable and appreciated. A couple of asks from our side before Procurement will sign: 
- We need an explicit credit memo that states how the 400k tokens translate to invoice dollars and which invoices it can be applied to.
- Please confirm whether the 30-day extension is retroactive (starting from the original trial end date) or starts on the amendment execution date.
- Can you also provide the SLA calculation you used to justify the credit amount (I want this for our internal audit).

Procurement is CC'd here (procurement@greenlinehealth.com). We prefer an amendment via DocuSign; PO is also acceptable if you need it.

Samir Shah
Head of Integrations
Greenline Health
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-03T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: approval needed — Greenline smoothing package (400k tokens + 30d)

Team —

Greenline saw a weekend latency regression (SUP-9876). External asked for a credit + extension; here's the proposal I sent: 400k tokens + 30-day trial extension + priority routing. They asked for a credit memo + DocuSign amendment.

Why I recommend approving:
- Customer is in active evaluation for Dedicated and is time-sensitive (regulatory onboarding).
- The incident impact is real and our mitigation window was outside their business-critical testing.
- The token credit is an inexpensive way to restore trust; we control application rules.

Financial impact: approx $10k gross list at current rates, likely less after negotiated discount.

Documents I will attach if we approve: credit_approval_form_2026-08-03.pdf (fillable), a one-paragraph credit memo, and the DocuSign amendment. Requesting: 
- Soojin — can you sign off from finance/billing? Prefer quick e-sign approach.
- Hannah — please confirm legal is OK with the amendment language (no SLA changes, only credit + extension).

If you approve, I’ll prepare the DocuSign and send to Samir + Procurement.

Thanks,
Marcus

Attachments: credit_approval_form_2026-08-03.pdf
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-03T11:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Internal: approval needed — Greenline smoothing package (400k tokens + 30d)

Marcus / Hannah —

Approved from finance with one constraint: cap the remediation at the lesser of 400k tokens OR $12,000 in billed credit value. That protects us in the event of rate changes or unforeseen discounting.

Hannah, legal: confirm the amendment is limited to a promotional credit and trial extension with no change to core terms. If that's accurate, I give the green light and will complete the approval form.

Marcus — once you have the DocuSign draft, send the link and I’ll complete the approval form electronically.

Sooj
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Samir Shah <samir.shah@greenlinehealth.com>, Procurement <procurement@greenlinehealth.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-04T17:22:00-07:00
Subject: Final: credit memo + DocuSign link (Greenline Health)

Samir / Procurement —

Thanks for your patience. Per internal approvals, attached is the official credit memo and the credit approval form has been completed by finance. Key points: 
- Credit: 400,000 tokens, to be applied as account-level invoice credit up to a cap of $12,000 (per finance approval).
- Trial extension: 30 days, which will start on amendment execution date.
- Activation: priority routing will be enabled after amendment execution.

DocuSign amendment (one-page) is ready here: https://docusign.example.com/Greenline-Amendment-1845
Please sign via DocuSign or send a PO with a signatory reference and we'll proceed. Once executed we’ll apply the credit and enable routing (usually within 24 hours of execution).

Samir, re: SLA calc — attached is a one-paragraph explanation and the incident timeline (see incident_report_2026-08-02.pdf). If you need more detail for audit, we can provide the underlying SRE runbook output.

Thanks — eager to get you back to comfortable performance.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Account Executive — Enterprise
Redwood Inference

Attachments: incident_report_2026-08-02.pdf, credit_approval_form_2026-08-03.pdf
